settings.title: What software does this course teach?
settings.text: This course is strictly focused on Adobe After Effects. It covers everything from the fundamentals to advanced motion graphics, VFX, speed ramping, keyframe animation, and professional editing techniques. Whether you're starting from scratch or looking to refine your skills, this course is built to take you from beginner to expert in Adobe After Effects.

settings.title: Do I need experience to take this course?
settings.text: No. This course is designed for all skill levels, whether you're completely new to Adobe After Effects or already have some experience and want to improve. Lessons are structured step by step, making it easy to follow along, even if you’ve never opened the software before.

settings.title: Will I get direct support if I have questions?
settings.text: Yes. When you enroll, you get direct access to me(DJordanMedia) inside our private Discord community. This means you can ask questions, get feedback on your edits, and receive guidance whenever you need it. This isn't just a course—it's personal mentorship to help you succeed in Adobe After Effects.

settings.title: How long do I have access to the course?
settings.text: You get lifetime access to the course, including all future updates at no extra cost. Adobe After Effects is always evolving, and this course ensures you stay ahead with the latest techniques, trends, and software updates.

settings.title: Why should I choose this course over free YouTube tutorials?
settings.text:
YouTube tutorials can show you bits and pieces of Adobe After Effects, but they don’t provide a clear learning path—which leaves many beginners feeling stuck and overwhelmed.

This course is different because it comes with direct mentorship and guidance to ensure you never get lost.

  • Structured, step-by-step lessons so you know exactly what to do next
  • Private Discord community where you can ask questions and get real-time answers
  • Personal feedback and guidance to help you improve faster
  • A clear path from beginner to expert, so you're not piecing together random videos

Instead of spending months watching tutorials without real progress, this course gives you everything you need in one place—along with expert support to help you succeed.

settings.title: Over 500 Creators Have Transformed Their Editing Skills

settings.text:
No Experience? No Problem. Learn Adobe After Effects from the Ground Up

Our courses are built to take you from absolute beginner to a professional video editor—no prior experience needed. Whether you're just starting out or refining your skills, you'll get a step-by-step learning experience designed to help you master Adobe After Effects with confidence. Over 450 members have already joined, building the expertise they need to succeed.

Get Direct Mentorship Inside Our Private Community

When you enroll, you’re not just getting a course—you’re getting direct access to mentorship and real support. Inside our private Discord group, you can:

  • Ask questions and get real-time answers
  • Share your work and receive expert feedback
  • Stay up to date with the latest editing trends
  • Connect with a network of serious video editors

Learning on your own can be frustrating, but with direct access to DJordanMedia and an engaged community of editors, you’ll never feel lost.

Master Editing Skills That Will Last a Lifetime

This isn’t just a course—it’s a long-term investment in your skills. The techniques you learn here will help you edit at a professional level for years to come. Whether you want to edit for content creation, client work, or high-end projects, you’ll gain the tools and workflow strategies needed to confidently tackle any project.

From Beginner to Expert—A Course Designed for Every Level

Whether you're completely new to Adobe After Effects or looking to master advanced techniques, this course is structured to guide you through every stage:

  • Start with the fundamentals—Master the core tools and techniques
  • Advance into motion graphics, keyframes, and VFX
  • Refine your workflow—Speed up editing with professional strategies
  • Go beyond the basics—Learn cutting-edge techniques to stand out

Everything is taught step by step, ensuring you stay on track and make real progress. This isn’t just a tutorial—it’s a complete system to help you master Adobe After Effects.
